source: example — historical rain events supplied by the client (illustrative). Apr 2024 and Mar 2026 already exist in config [scenarios.events]; use this file for further events or to override windows.
notes: rows[].event_id is the key (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD recommended); date or start/end define the window that field observations and 993 reports are attributed to; p24_mm is the default 24-h depth, p24_by_area optional; scenario_key maps the event to a model scenario (omit to leave unmapped). Place the real file at exchange/events.json, POST it to /api/feed/events, or set [feeds.events].url.
